picks.rationale: Hold the Stafford–Nacua passing pairing. Current platform eligibility and salaries are unchanged; reduced passing volume in a controlled Rams win remains a risk.
Hold the Rams backfield anchor alongside the passing pairing. It provides a rushing route to production but retains three-player Rams concentration.
Hold the verified $5,700 lead-back opportunity with Hall out. The Jets' team report documents heavy recent participation; the matchup and receiving workload still limit certainty.
Hold the premium Rams receiver. There is no observed new injury designation or eligibility change requiring a replacement.
Hold the Giants receiving anchor. The protection concern remains unresolved; retaining him with Likely accepts shared offensive risk.
Hold the $4,000 receiver with Wilson and Skowronek out. The Steelers identify Bernard as an increasingly trusted option, but Metcalf is cleared; do not assume Bernard inherits every missing target.
Hold the $4,100 tight end to preserve the established salary allocation. The refreshed single-model estimate supports retaining him; it does not establish a certain rebound.
Hold the morning FLEX change to Likely. Theo Johnson remains out and the previously documented receiving case remains intact; protection duties could still suppress routes.
Hold Pittsburgh at $3,300 against a Tampa Bay team with Mayfield ruled out. Secondary injuries and turnover/return variance remain explicit risks.

chosen_lineup_ref.adopted_fields: All nine player identities, roster slots, teams/opponents/home flags, official player IDs and original salaries; unchanged. Freeze projections are a separate newer estimate snapshot.

original_salary_snapshot.note: Original morning salary snapshot remains unchanged; fresh official export confirms the selected fields.

decision_summary: Freeze the morning nine unchanged. Fresh official checks preserve the lead-back, receiving-opportunity and backup-QB matchup cases; no observed material contradiction warrants a replacement. Do not force a full $50,000 spend.

projection_comparison.note: Same nine players and original prices. The 0.1-point display change is entirely a provider-model refresh.

availability.note: No selected player is flagged OUT/IR in the retrieved export or listed with an injury designation in the inspected report. Final game-day active status is not certified; the observed Giants tracker has no current Week 6 inactive list.

strongest_counterargument: The build still relies on three Rams and two Giants. Both Giants starting tackles remain questionable in the observed official report, so extra protection could reduce Likely's receiving routes and hurt both Giants selections. Bernard's opportunity is also a role assumption, not a guaranteed target count.
unresolved_assumptions: Final game-day active status remains unverified at this cutoff; later official inactive lists may add information.
Giants protection and Likely's receiving/blocking allocation remain uncertain.
Bernard's increased opportunity with two receivers out becomes useful targets despite Metcalf being cleared.
The Rams generate enough offense for three selections even if they control the game.
Braelon Allen's lead role offsets matchup and receiving uncertainty.
Current canonical rules body did not render; verify DST points-allowed attribution exceptions and stat finality before a reproduced actual score.
post_freeze_policy: This exact scored selection is fixed. Later inactives, injuries, news, estimates and results are append-only observations/reviews. They cannot replace the selected players or original salaries, even before kickoff.
actual_points_state: All actual points and team actual total remain null before target games.

scoring_reference.verified: Public contest roster/cap and current official export eligibility; platform-published offensive/DST point tables rechecked.
scoring_reference.limits: Full canonical rules body unavailable. No actual scoring is calculated. Resolve DST attribution exceptions before postgame calculation.
